# ssh-check.sh

<!-- Generated by tools/Build-Catalog.ps1. Edit the script header, not this file. -->

Test SSH (TCP 22) reachability of network devices, filtered by client and device type.

| | |
|---|---|
| Location | `scripts/network/ssh-check.sh` |
| Platform | macOS / Linux (bash; uses nc if present) |
| Permissions | None (read access to ~/.ssh/config.d) |
| Safety | Read-only (opens a TCP connection, sends no data) |

## When to use

Before or after a network change window, to confirm which switches, routers and firewalls answer.
